description.zh: 要查询防护场景。更多信息，请参见[CreateDefenseRule](~~461421~~)的**DefenseScene**参数，当防护规则类型 **DefenseType**为**template**的取值范围。
description.en: The protection scenario of the protection template. For more information, see the valid values for the **DefenseScene** parameter in [CreateDefenseRule](~~461421~~) when **DefenseType** is set to **template**.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of your WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为**1**。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置每页返回防护对象的数量。默认值为**20**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **20**.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The name of the protected object that you want to query. You can specify this parameter to filter the results.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh:
防护模板ID。


> 当不设置该参数时，可用于创建该防护场景（**DefenseScene**）模版时查询待关联的防护对象列表。
description.en:
The ID of the protection template.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the protected objects that can be associated with a new protection template for the specified protection scenario (**DefenseScene**) are returned.

title.zh: 查询防护模版待生效防护对象列表
